display_aspect: 4:3; derivatives explicitly recorded in each display-provenance.json
models: Mark, Amy, Joshua, Sara and Amanda; full and actual gameplay LOD six-view galleries plus source-room conversations. Amy lying/awake tested separately.
limits: Free-heap minima describe only these Water Club model/room/conversation fixtures with a retained full-production resident budget plus bench allowance. They do not establish maximum duel/story/save-service heap use or physical-hardware frame rate. Awake Amy retains source-faithful foreground Joshua; production cameras and visibility were unchanged.

resident_memory_proof.method: Actual normal production main entry graph (DIAGNOSTIC=0) and duel/story roots retained. Any measured resident deficit plus a 16 KiB bench allowance is reserved as retained static BSS before rendering. Both allocatable section sum and LOAD end must meet the conservative floor.

visual_identity.method: Every new full-resident-budget framebuffer matches the previously accepted RGBA pixel hash exactly; the twelve selected native frames also match those feeding the original VI art captures.

vi_provenance_scope: The twelve preserved original VI PNGs were recorded earlier from the smaller art-only diagnostic ROM (13381677...). They prove filtered appearance, not full-game memory headroom. The corrected full-resident-budget ROM (ae52dd82...) was recaptured for all60 native frames, with identical visual pixels. No additional VI recapture was needed or performed.
